item.title: Roland JX-70 / JX-10 rack mount note to LED addition
item.description: video upload by Craig Barnes "I had finished this project, but originally the 16 patch and bank buttons were dual LEDs. Today I started to replace them with blanks and thought, what if I leave patch buttons 1-6 as dual LEDs and add a simple processor to intercept the serial Comms between the assigner board and the voice boards. Effectively creating a midi to trigger to display the notes as LEDs."

item.title: "A song for the sad ones" by gattobus (Frap Tools Magnolia)
item.description: video upload by gattobus "The song can be downloaded here: A song for the sad ones by gattobus This song was born a few months ago while I was programming some patches for Magnolia. I'm not having a great time right now, but luckily, as sometimes happens, music has come to help me. This song carries hope and all my wishes for peace and serenity. All synth sounds are from Frap Tools Magnolia.
